server_file.label: Home Assistant server file
server_file.description: File containing the Home Assistant base URL. This keeps the URL outside the declarative plugin config.

token_file.label: Home Assistant token file
token_file.description: File containing a long-lived Home Assistant token. It is read only at runtime and never stored by the plugin.

allow_insecure_tls.label: Allow insecure TLS
allow_insecure_tls.description: Skip HTTPS certificate verification. Use only for a trusted Home Assistant with a self-signed certificate.

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often to rediscover active Home Assistant usage metrics.

dashboard_path.label: Home Assistant link path
dashboard_path.description: Relative path opened by the panel's Home Assistant link, appended to the server URL. For example: /mi-casa/data#ai-quotas.

reset_time_format.label: Reset-time format
reset_time_format.description: How reset timestamps are rendered in the tooltip and panel.

warning_color.label: Warning color
warning_color.description: Color at or above the warning threshold.

critical_color.label: Critical color
critical_color.description: Color at or above the critical threshold.

ring_normal_color.label: Ring color
ring_normal_color.description: Ring color while the window still has plenty of time left.

ring_warning_color.label: Ring warning color
ring_warning_color.description: Ring color once less than a quarter of the window remains.

ring_critical_color.label: Ring critical color
ring_critical_color.description: Ring color once less than a tenth of the window remains.

warning_threshold.label: Warning threshold (%)
warning_threshold.description: Usage percentage that switches to the warning color.

critical_threshold.label: Critical threshold (%)
critical_threshold.description: Usage percentage that switches to the critical color.

display_mode.label: Bar display mode
display_mode.description: Icon is the compact icon-only mode; summary and detailed both show discovered metrics per the toggles below.

metric_limit.label: Bar metric limit
metric_limit.description: Maximum number of discovered usage metrics displayed in this bar instance.

card_filter.label: Bar cards
card_filter.description: Optional comma-separated card names or account fragments to show, matched case-insensitively. For example: Pro, Gemini, Codex. Leave empty to show all discovered cards.

metric_window.label: Bar quota window
metric_window.description: Choose the 5h/session or weekly quota displayed in the bar. Providers with category-only quotas remain visible.

show_name.label: Show metric name
show_name.description: Show Home Assistant's discovered metric label in the bar.

show_value.label: Show percentage
show_value.description: Show the usage percentage in the bar. It remains available in the tooltip and panel when disabled.

show_progress.label: Show progress bar
show_progress.description: Show a compact usage bar beside each metric.

show_reset.label: Show reset time
show_reset.description: Show a reset time in the bar when the integration exposes one.

show_remaining.label: Show remaining instead of used
show_remaining.description: Invert percentage labels while retaining usage-colored progress bars. Only visible when "Show percentage" is also enabled -- there's no percentage label to invert otherwise.

spacing.label: Bar spacing
spacing.description: Gap inside a card in pixels; cards are separated by twice this.
